decisions.reason: The complete-video reference direction affects the opening hook, but that effect is already fully represented by the candidate's message-83 MODIFY.
The candidate already has a complete message-83 MODIFY establishing the last reference as the complete-video model and defining the adaptation mode.
Using the last reference as the complete-video model does not necessarily cancel the independently specified keyword sources, required terms, or wording restrictions.
The source changes the reference model and benefit selection but does not alter the Hindi-only language requirement.
Recreating the last reference does not change the specified Indian target market or audience age range.
The source does not mention or necessarily alter the requirement for an organically incorporated call to action.

The instruction to set creativity aside and recreate the complete reference may supersede the prior testimonial presentation, but the supplied evidence does not reveal the reference video's format or the safe replacement values.
The reference and benefit changes do not alter the required video count, duration, or aspect ratios.
The source does not change the requested audio level or advertising mix standard and does not resolve the existing audio-value ambiguity.
Using the reference as the complete-video model does not necessarily replace the independently required suitable-cut standard.
The source changes the creative reference but does not relax or replace the requirement for realistic, non-obviously-AI visual execution.
The freelancer remains responsible for complete production, including footage, voiceover, and script; the reference change does not alter that responsibility.
